notes: deliver to thee: the supplied preposition is what the English verb's valency needs to reach the verb's own bare object suffix, so it joins the verb's unit while the suffix keeps only thee (rule 44's suffix clause).
Each construct noun takes the single indefinite determiner written before its own word (rules 15, 29), and each rectum takes the chain's of (rule 19).
The margin's Or, glory was read and set aside (rule 38).
